policy_metadata.policy_name: Consumer Smartphone Hardware Warranty Policy - Pakistan Region
policy_metadata.jurisdiction: Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) Act 1996 / Consumer Protection Acts (Punjab/Sindh/KP/ICT)

warranty_start_conditions.primary_trigger: Date of retail purchase invoice from an authorized national distributor or official brand retail store
warranty_start_conditions.regulatory_compliance_mandate: Device IMEI 1 and IMEI 2 must be officially registered and tax-cleared under the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) Device Identification, Registration and Blocking System (DIRBS). Devices with CPID patched, non-PTA approved, or cloned IMEI numbers are strictly ineligible for warranty services
prerequisites: Computerized retail purchase invoice showing retailer NTN, purchase date, phone model, and printed IMEI 1 and 2
Official distributor warranty card bearing matching IMEI barcode sticker and retailer stamp
Official cloud device registration timestamp matching purchase date within a 30-day tolerance

covered_faults: Logic board (motherboard) component failures: sudden dead boot (PMIC failure, UFS memory degradation, SoC thermal detachment under non-tampered conditions)

Display and digitizer manufacturing defects: spontaneous vertical/horizontal colored lines (e.g. green/pink lines on AMOLED/OLED displays post-OTA update without physical drop/bezel stress), multi-touch dead zones, or persistent ghost touch

Camera module hardware failure: optical image stabilization (OIS) actuator oscillation chatter, autofocus voice coil motor (VCM) seizure, or internal sensor image banding (excluding external lens scratch/laser burn)
Charging sub-board and USB-C port failure: pin solder detachment or fast-charge handshake failure under dry, corrosion-free conditions
Acoustic transducer failures: internal ear speaker, loudspeaker, or MEMS microphone audio codec IC failure
Cellular baseband failure: persistent 'No Service' or invalid SIM error where SIM slot is undamaged and PTA registration is verified
Battery hardware failure: severe pouch swelling/bloating separating the back cover, sudden shutdown at battery levels exceeding 20%, or thermal battery warning preventing charge
Foldable / Flip screen mechanical hinge creaking, tension spring disengagement, or Ultra-Thin Glass (UTG) stress crease delamination under standard opening limits
exclusions: Non-PTA compliant devices, grey market parallel imports, or handsets with modified, patched, or duplicated IMEI numbers (CPID patch, root patch, cloned feature phone IMEI)
Liquid, moisture, or chemical ingress: verified by triggered internal or SIM-tray Liquid Damage Indicator (LDI) turning pink or red, or visible corrosion on FPC flex connectors

Physical impact and accidental damage: shattered front cover glass, fractured back glass panel, dented or bent aluminum/titanium frame, display ink bleed / black pooling / internal AMOLED puncture beneath unbroken glass
Unauthorized operating system modifications: unlocked bootloader, custom ROM, rooted Android kernel (e.g. Knox counter trip 0x1, Magisk root, unverified test-keys build)

Unauthorized repair or parts substitution: non-original aftermarket replacement screen (e.g. cheap TFT/incell screen fitted in place of original OLED), missing internal shielding brackets, or work performed at local repair markets (Hall Road Lahore, Techno City Karachi, Saddar Karachi, Singapore Plaza Rawalpindi)
Severe OLED burn-in or permanent static image retention caused by operating continuously at 100% manual brightness on static icons for over 8 consecutive hours
Sub-board or battery burnout caused by charging via counterfeit non-certified fast chargers (e.g. uncertified 67W/120W clone adapters) or unstable direct DC vehicular supplies
Surface cosmetic abrasions, minor micro-scratches on protective display film, frame paint chipping, or lens cover scuffs resulting from regular pocket/bag friction

repair_conditions.spare_parts_origin: 100% Genuine OEM factory-sealed replacement modules supplied directly by brand regional spare parts hubs
repair_conditions.dust_free_bench_standard: Screen and logic board replacements are performed exclusively inside ESD-controlled, Class 1000 dust-free clean benches utilizing factory hot-press jig machines to re-establish IP67/IP68 water resistance gaskets
repair_conditions.data_sanitization_mandate: Diagnostic firmware flashing and motherboard replacement necessitate complete device wiping. Customer must back up personal data, media, and chat histories prior to handover
repair_conditions.security_locks_requirement: Customer must remove Google Account (FRP), Apple ID, Samsung Account, Xiaomi/Mi Account, and lock screen passcodes before device check-in
repair_conditions.repaired_parts_post_warranty_policy: Replaced modular components carry a 90-day warranty or the remaining unexpired manufacturer warranty, whichever is greater

authorized_service_centre_requirement.mandate: Warranty services are administered exclusively through official brand customer care centers and certified franchise service networks across Pakistan
authorized_service_centre_requirement.intake_inspection: Mandatory microscopic 10x inspection of display bezel, SIM tray LDI, and USB-C port pins during check-in; photographic proof logged to digital warranty portal
authorized_service_centre_requirement.unauthorized_access_penalty: Any missing internal grounding bracket screws, non-original adhesive pull tabs, or third-party technician markings result in immediate and permanent voiding of warranty status

replacement_conditions.doa_conditions: Dead on Arrival (DOA) replacement authorized within 7 calendar days from invoice purchase date if verified by ASC Lead Engineer to exhibit unrepairable hardware defect, zero cosmetic scratches on glass/housing, and complete retail box with matching serial IMEI sticker
replacement_conditions.unresolved_repeat_failure_condition: Failure of the core logic board occurring 3 consecutive times within 90 days of previous repairs
replacement_conditions.parts_backorder_condition: Failure of national parts depot to provide required replacement assembly within 21 calendar days from job card issuance
replacement_conditions.replacement_tier: Brand-new sealed handset of the identical model, color, and storage configuration, or superseding equivalent model if the original SKU is out of production

mandatory_documents: Original Retail Purchase Invoice detailing customer name, purchase date, phone model, IMEI 1 & IMEI 2, and retailer NTN/STRN
Original National Distributor Warranty Card (Airlink, M&P, Core, etc.) with matching IMEI barcode sticker
PTA DIRBS 8484 verification confirmation SMS or official PTA online portal verification slip showing valid tax-paid status for both IMEIs
Original CNIC copy of the purchasing customer matching invoice name

hard_fail_rules.condition: pta_dirbs_verified == false || cpid_patched_imei == true || imei_dual_sim_mismatch == true
hard_fail_rules.description: Device is not PTA compliant or exhibits patched/cloned IMEI; violating Pakistani telecommunication laws. Claim strictly rejected.

hard_fail_rules.condition: sim_tray_ldi_triggered == true || internal_motherboard_ldi_triggered == true || usb_port_corroded == true
hard_fail_rules.description: Internal or external liquid contact indicator turned red/pink or active corrosion present; liquid damage excludes all warranty coverage.

hard_fail_rules.condition: aftermarket_screen_detected == true || missing_internal_shielding_screws == true || unauthorized_bazaar_seal == true
hard_fail_rules.description: Device contains non-OEM replacement parts (e.g. aftermarket screen) or exhibits third-party local repair shop intervention.

hard_fail_rules.rule_name: Accidental Physical Impact or Display Bleed
hard_fail_rules.condition: screen_glass_shattered == true || frame_bent == true || oled_internal_ink_bleed == true
hard_fail_rules.description: Cracked cover glass, bent frame, or internal OLED matrix bleeding resulting from drop impact or external force.

hard_fail_rules.condition: bootloader_unlocked == true || root_binary_present == true || knox_tripped_0x1 == true
hard_fail_rules.description: System integrity compromised via bootloader unlocking, custom ROM installation, or root manipulation.
Claim lodged more than 7 calendar days following expiration of the standard 365-day warranty period.
Charging sub-board and PMIC destruction caused by non-certified counterfeit high-wattage clone fast chargers.

warning_rules.rule_name: Spontaneous OLED Line Following Official OTA Update
warning_rules.condition: vertical_green_or_pink_line_present == true && glass_undamaged == true && frame_undamaged == true && ota_update_within_14_days == true
warning_rules.warning_message: Single vertical OLED line manifested after official OTA firmware update without physical impact. Screen replacement may qualify for special brand subsidy.
warning_rules.action_required: Escalate to brand technical desk for manufacturer goodwill screen replacement program authorization.

warning_rules.warning_message: Battery health is slightly above the 80% replacement threshold with over 400 charge cycles, indicating standard electrochemical aging.
warning_rules.action_required: Notify customer that battery meets nominal operating performance standards; replacement is currently billable unless health drops below 80% within 12 months.

warning_rules.rule_name: Active Cloud Anti-Theft / FRP Lock Engaged
warning_rules.condition: google_frp_locked == true || mi_cloud_locked == true || apple_id_locked == true
warning_rules.warning_message: Device submitted with active cloud security lock. Factory diagnostic tools cannot initialize.
warning_rules.action_required: Contact claimant immediately to remove cloud anti-theft bindings remotely or provide registered proof of ownership credentials.

warning_rules.warning_message: Defect reported after the mandatory 3-day window. Perform high-magnification inspection to confirm absence of subsequent drop trauma.
warning_rules.action_required: Verify internal accelerometer crash telemetry logs to ensure no drop events occurred between symptom onset and service submission.

warning_rules.rule_name: Cosmetic Oleophobic Wear and Surface Micro-Scratches
warning_rules.warning_message: Display exhibits surface micro-scratches from pocket grit. Cosmetic wear is excluded from coverage.
warning_rules.action_required: Advise customer that screen replacement for cosmetic scratches is purely customer-paid.

manual_review_trigger_rules.trigger_reason: Customer requests immediate brand-new DOA handset replacement within 7 calendar days of retail purchase.
Handset has undergone two prior motherboard replacements and failed a third time; review for complete handset replacement.

manual_review_trigger_rules.rule_name: Service Center SLA Breach (21+ Days Parts Delay)
manual_review_trigger_rules.trigger_reason: Authorized service center unable to source genuine display or logic board within 21 calendar days of check-in.

manual_review_trigger_rules.rule_name: Contested Spontaneous Green Line with Microscopic Bezel Scuff
manual_review_trigger_rules.condition: vertical_green_or_pink_line_present == true && microscopic_bezel_nick == true && customer_appeals_decision == true
manual_review_trigger_rules.trigger_reason: Customer contests rejection where technician cited minor frame scuff as cause of spontaneous AMOLED line failure.

manual_review_trigger_rules.rule_name: Retail Channel Date Discrepancy / Suspected Stale Stock
manual_review_trigger_rules.trigger_reason: Device was first activated on cellular network more than 45 days prior to invoice date; suspected open-box resale or dealer stock recycling.
